title: Micro Assistant
description: Shows which counting relics and powers each card play affects - on the hovered card, and above the End Turn button.
changeNote: v0.13.0: the Setup Relics bar is on by default and captioned "Setup Relics"; the banner for what a card play is about to set off is captioned "Will trigger:" over its icons. The badge scale slider now starts at 1.5 and sizes the mod's own panels directly - Scale Always On extends it to the End Turn badges and unfocused hand cards.
